title: PaperOS session footer
description: The JSON object inside the fenced ```paperos-session block that ends every Linear comment a PaperOS session posts (docs/pm/session-playbook.md, PAP-92). Parsed by the orchestrator (PAP-96) to set issue state, by PAP-97/PAP-98 for status and cost, and rendered by PAP-105 linear-update.

playbookVersion.description: Version of the session playbook the footer follows. 1 and 2 both validate against the current rules (v2 only widened the enums below and relaxed `branch`); the parser accepts either. Bumped only when a field is added, removed or renamed.

sessionId.description: <yyyy-mm-dd>-PAP-<n>, with an optional -<k> suffix when an issue is re-run the same day.

character.description: Name of the lead character that ran the session (case-insensitive: either casing validates), `orchestrator` for comments the orchestrator posts itself (status `promoted`), `integrator` for the merge-queue's comments (status `integrated`), or `scribe` for housekeeping/remediation passes (PAP-92).

issue.description: Linear identifier of the issue the comment sits on.

status.description: started | progress | ended | partial | contract-failed | handoff are posted by sessions; review | reviewed are posted by the review pass (verdict required, see the `verdict` property); promoted is posted by the PAP-96 promotion pass (templates/promoted.md); integrated is posted by the merge-queue integrator when it lands a branch on main; remediation is posted by a housekeeping/contradiction-fixing pass (PAP-92).

verdict.description: The review pass's outcome. Required when `status` is `review` or `reviewed`; absent otherwise.

branch.description: Working branch, e.g. feat/PAP-92-session-playbook or <parent>/wp2-<slug>. For status `promoted` this is the branch the promoted issue will use (may be a placeholder until claim). Required only on started/progress/ended/partial, where the session is working on or reporting from one branch; absent on review/reviewed/promoted/integrated/remediation, which describe or act on a branch rather than work on it.

model.description: Model id the session ran on (claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, claude-haiku-4-5).

costUsd.description: Spend so far in US dollars (PAP-98 live total). Required on ended/partial when the session knows it; the orchestrator fills it otherwise.

pr.description: PR URL in target (PR) mode. Absent in build-loop mode, where `commits` carries the integration evidence.

commits.description: SHAs pushed to main (build-loop mode) or to the branch, oldest first.

baseBranches.description: Echo of the BASE_BRANCHES prompt variable set by PAP-96 promotion: the In Review blockers' branches merged into the worktree before coding. Omitted when empty.

reason.description: Why a session stopped early. Known values: duplicate-claim, needs-spec, base-branch-conflict, budget, justin-stop, killed, base-pr-closed.

handoff.$comment: Owned by PAP-108 (packages/agents/src/handoff.ts, HandoffSchema). This inline copy is the $ref target until PAP-108 publishes handoff.schema.json; then this $defs entry becomes {"$ref": "./handoff.schema.json"} and nothing else changes.
